templateOptions.label: Connection string
templateOptions.description:
For Azure SQL authentication, use the following format:
Server=<server>.database.windows.net,1433;Database=<database>;Encrypt=True;TrustServerCertificate=False;Connection Timeout=25;

templateOptions.label: Table
templateOptions.description: The table in which the blocklist values reside

templateOptions.label: Retention Period (days)
templateOptions.description: The number of days a deleted value should remain blocked. After this period, the value can be reused. Use 999999 for no retention limit.

templateOptions.label: Username
templateOptions.description: Optional: The username of the SQL user to use in the connection string

templateOptions.label: Password
templateOptions.description: Optional: The username of the SQL user to use in the connection string

When toggled, the connection will use a certificate to retrieve an access token for Azure SQL authentication. When disabled, the connection will use the provided username and password for local SQL authentication.
templateOptions.label: Use Azure SQL authentication
